Edward Makomborero Sigauke (born 28 January 2004) is a Zimbabwean international rugby union player based in South Africa. Educated at Lomagundi College in Chinhoyi, Sigauke captained the Zimbabwe under 20s in the 2024 Barthés Trophy, before making his senior Sables debut in the 2024 Rugby Africa Cup against Uganda.
